scenes.say: Imagine this. Your roof faces east and west. No south side at all.

lines: South is best in the US…
scenes.say: In the US, south-facing panels produce the most energy over a year.
But east and west-facing panels typically produce only ten to twenty percent less. Usually still worthwhile.
And west-facing panels can be worth even more under time-of-use rates and net billing, because they produce later in the day.
Most roof pitches, from about fifteen to forty degrees, are close enough to optimal.
Wondering about your roof? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
